simple.summary: חֲפָרַיִם (Chăphârayim) means Chapharajim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 19.

definitions.full: H2663. Chapharayim חֲפָרַיִם proper name, of a location in Issachar Josh 19:19 , ᵐ5 Αγειν , A Αφεραειμ , ᵐ5 L Αμφαραιμ ; = Egyptian „a-pu-ru-m-â WMM Asien,170 ; site dubious, 6 miles north of Legio according to Lag Onom. 223, 2nd ed. 241.
